summaries.summary: The extension code only defines activate and deactivate functions and logs a message on activation. It has no network, file system, child process, credential, obfuscation, or persistence behavior. Its capabilities are proportional to the stated minimal marketplace upload test purpose, and no behavioral mismatch or capability disconnect is present.
